method: Built-in image_gen.imagegen, two concurrent independent calls. No CLI/API fallback and no model selector. Source reference inspected for emerald/ivory palette and translucency only; no reference image passed to generation. PNGs copied byte-for-byte. Pillow WebP encoding: A RGB quality=88 method=6; B RGBA quality=90 method=6 exact=true. Original B alpha preserved and compared after WebP decoding.

prompts.A:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production website research laboratory bench backdrop for a premium business science platform, intended for subtle WebGL distortion and GSAP parallax.
Primary request: create a wide landscape 3:2 cinematic photorealistic laboratory still-life with extraordinary physical depth and elegant, naturally refractive scientific glass.
Scene/backdrop: a dark research laboratory bench in deep forest green and ink black, with restrained polished reflections and a softly receding almost-black room.
Subject: glass culture dishes containing emerald liquid, a small group of capped specimen vials, a finely made microfluidic glass chip, and minimal precise stainless laboratory hardware. Make each item credible and tactile, premium and real.
Style/medium: highest-fidelity photorealistic 3D macro product photography, refined organic scientific beauty, delicate glass translucency and physical refraction, natural imperfections, sophisticated business science.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 landscape; low close camera grazing the bench, layered foreground and background; instruments concentrated on the right 65%, with the entire left 45% predominantly very dark quiet negative space for a large headline. Objects enter the composition gently from the center toward the right. Strong depth, foreground glass curves and distant small vials, no cramped clutter.
Lighting/mood: calm cinematic emerald and warm ivory highlights, a soft luminous rim on clear glass, physically plausible caustics and specular reflections, rich nuanced shadows, restrained soft focus in depth. The focal glass details are beautifully sharp.
Color palette: near-black forest green, emerald aqueous liquid, clear ivory glass highlights, a little fine brushed stainless steel.
Text: none.
Constraints: no people, no letters, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no fake data, no UI, no HUD, no diagram, no planet, no orbit, no blue neon. Avoid a science fiction or video game look. Keep the scene quiet, premium, physically credible, and composed for headline legibility.
